### Collection data

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async function () {
const pubJson = "intermediates/publications.json"; 
const targetDoi = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));

if (!targetDoi) {
setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('error-message', 'block', "No DOI specified in the URL.");
return;
}

try {
await Promise.all([
updateElementWithData(pubJson, 'pub-title', 'ArticleTitle'),
updateElementWithData(pubJson, 'pub-abstract', 'AbstractText'),
updateElementWithData(pubJson, 'pub-journal', 'Title'),
updateElementWithDataAndLink(pubJson, 'pub-doi-link', 'DOI', 'DOI', 'https://doi.org/'),
updateElementWithDataAndLink(pubJson, 'pub-pmid-link', 'PMID', 'PMID', 'https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/')
]);

const titleText = document.getElementById('pub-title').textContent;
if (titleText && titleText !== "ID or property not found") {
document.title = titleText;
}

setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('publication-info', 'block');

const allCollections = await fetchWithCache('intermediates/final_dat.json');
const mapPoints = Object.values(allCollections).filter(row => row.DOI === targetDoi && row.lat && row.long);

if (mapPoints.length > 0) {
const mapContainer = document.getElementById('pub-map');
mapContainer.style.display = 'block';

const map = L.map('pub-map');
L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors &copy; CARTO'
}).addTo(map);

const bounds = L.latLngBounds();

mapPoints.forEach(pt => {
  const customHtml = `<div class="marker-container"><a href="collection.html?${pt.ID}" target="_blank" class="marker-link">${pt.ID}</a><span class="city-tooltip"></span></div>`;
  
  const invisibleIcon = L.divIcon({ 
    className: 'empty-icon', 
    html: '', 
    iconSize: [0, 0] 
  });

  L.marker([parseFloat(pt.lat), parseFloat(pt.long)], {icon: invisibleIcon})
    .bindTooltip(customHtml, {
      permanent: true,
      direction: "center",
      className: "custom-map-label",
      interactive: true
    })
    .addTo(map);
    
  bounds.extend([parseFloat(pt.lat), parseFloat(pt.long)]);
});

setTimeout(() => {
map.invalidateSize();
map.fitBounds(bounds, {maxZoom: 11, padding: [30, 30]});
}, 100);
}

} catch (error) {
console.error(error);
setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('error-message', 'block', "Error loading publication data.");
}
});
</script>

library(DT)
library(dplyr)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

datatable(dat[, c("ID", "Tick species", "Source", "Collection year start", "Collection year end", "Collection site", "LID", "DOI")], 
          escape = FALSE, 
          style = "bootstrap5",
          class = "wrap",
          filter = "top",
          extensions = c("Select", "SearchPanes", "Buttons"), 
          selection = "none",
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            dom = "PBfrtip",
            buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
            searchPanes = list(initCollapsed = TRUE, viewCount = FALSE),
            columnDefs = list(
              list(targets = c(6L:7), visible = FALSE),
              list(targets = c(0, 3L:7), searchPanes = list(show = FALSE)),
              list(targets = 0, render = render_collection),
              list(targets = c(1L:2), 
                   searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, orthogonal = "sp"),
                   render = JS("function(data, type, row, meta) {
                                  if (type === 'sp') {
                                    return data ? data.split(',').map(function(item) { return item.trim(); }) : data;
                                  }
                                return data;
                               }"))
            ),
            initComplete = JS("
              function(settings, json) {
                let targetDoi = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));
                
                console.log(targetDoi);
                
                if (targetDoi) {
                  var api = this.api();
                  api.column(-1).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(targetDoi) + '$', true, false).draw();
                } 
              }
            ")
          )
)
